title: A package connects several physical scales
caption: The package supports the die, carries power and signals, and helps transfer heat. Fine connections near silicon fan out toward a coarser board interface.

nodes.label: Die
nodes.detail: Contains delicate circuitry and fine connection points.

nodes.label: Joints
nodes.detail: Join the die to the receiving wiring structure.

nodes.label: Board interface
nodes.detail: Connects the component to the wider system.

title: Prepare a wafer for safe die separation
caption: Thinning reduces stiffness and can introduce damage. Support and controlled separation protect the selected good dies.

nodes.label: Backgrind
nodes.detail: Remove silicon from the rear as required.

nodes.label: Support and finish
nodes.detail: Manage thin-wafer handling and subsurface damage.

nodes.label: Separate
nodes.detail: Release individual dies along the designated streets.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Peripheral wires or an area of joints
caption: Wire bonding reaches die-edge pads. Flip-chip assembly faces the active surface toward the receiving structure and distributes connections across an area.

nodes.label: Wire bond
nodes.detail: Fine wires arc between die pads and package contacts.

nodes.label: Flip chip
nodes.detail: Bumps or pillars join facing contact arrays.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Fine wiring can use different constructions
caption: CoWoS variants differ in their interposer or redistribution structure. A common product label does not imply an identical physical stack.

nodes.label: CoWoS-S
nodes.detail: A silicon interposer supports fine die-to-die wiring.

nodes.label: CoWoS-R
nodes.detail: An RDL interposer provides the fine redistribution.

nodes.label: CoWoS-L
nodes.detail: Local silicon connections combine with an RDL structure.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: One weak input can threaten the combined assembly
caption: Early screening protects value that would otherwise be committed to difficult-to-rework joints and interfaces.

nodes.label: Compute die
nodes.detail: A valuable die with its own test history.

nodes.label: Memory stacks
nodes.detail: Each stack brings separate yield and test evidence.

nodes.label: Wiring structure
nodes.detail: Interposer and substrate must meet their own requirements.

nodes.label: Completed assembly

title: Hybrid bonding joins surfaces directly
caption: Hybrid bonding brings dielectric surfaces and metal connections together. Cleanliness, flatness and alignment are essential to making both interfaces meet.

nodes.label: Solder-based joints
nodes.detail: Raised joints connect separated die surfaces.

nodes.label: Hybrid bond
nodes.detail: Prepared dielectric and metal surfaces bond directly.
